title: DIR-013: AI Multi-Provider Engine Modernization, Old-vs-New Parity, Deep Links, Modals, 5-Viewport Playwright E2E & Full Subsystem Integration
spec:
# SECTION 1 — EXECUTIVE MANDATE & ARCHITECTURAL OBJECTIVE
Directive ID: DIR-013
Title: AI Multi-Provider Engine Modernization, Old-vs-New Parity, Deep Links, Modals, 5-Viewport Playwright E2E & Full Subsystem Integration
Target Route: https://ime365.local/admin/ai-settings (Admin Console -> AI Multi-Provider Engine)
Priority: P0 (Critical Production UI/UX Overhaul, Deep-Link Architecture & Multi-Device Verification)
Executive Engineering Lead: Antigravity (Google DeepMind)
Implementation Engine: Cline / Claude Code CLI
Governance: 5-Hour Autonomous Execution Contract — Strict Gatekeeping & True 10/10 Standards

### 1.1 Objective & Strategic Mandate:
The developer must completely elevate the AI Multi-Provider Engine (frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAiSettingsTab.tsx) to world-class enterprise standards, ensuring it is highly advanced, modern, intelligent, aesthetically stunning, and properly integrated with all relevant modules and subsystems across IME365.

The developer must:
1. Conduct an exhaustive Old vs. New comparative audit (comparing legacy platform provider configurations in PlatformTenants.jsx lines 1558-1650 and legacy aiRouting against the new FreeLLMAPI Unified Gateway).
2. Enhance UI/UX to match Google Material Design 3 and Cuba executive glassmorphic standards.
3. Validate and harden all deep links, URL query params, and tab state management.
4. Audit and polish all modal dialogs and popup drawers (focus trapping, keyboard navigation, responsive containment).
5. Ensure 100% Real Data Display (zero fake data arrays or dummy mock placeholders; real SQLite metrics, real MariaDB credentials, real live provider latency pinging).
6. Execute comprehensive Playwright E2E browser tests across all 5 responsive viewports (375x667, 768x1024, 1024x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080), saving full-resolution visual evidence to docs/ui-audit/screenshots/freellmapi/.
7. Guarantee seamless end-to-end integration across all dependent platform modules (Candidate Resume Builder, Interview Coach, Super Admin, Enterprise BYOK, and Developer SDK surface).

---

# SECTION 2 — OLD VS. NEW COMPARATIVE AUDIT & FEATURE PARITY
The developer must document a comprehensive comparative matrix in the plan:
- Legacy Reference: PlatformTenants.jsx (lines 1558-1650), legacy single-key forms in admin settings, and legacy backend/services/aiRouting/.
- Modern Reference: frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAiSettingsTab.tsx and backend/freellmapi/.
- Required Parity & Enhancements:
  a) Provider Catalog: Old supported ~6 hardcoded providers; new must support 34+ providers across Fast, Frontier, Vision, Keyless, and Reasoning categories.
  b) Multi-Key Pooling: Old had single key per provider; new must support multi-key pool arrays, key rotation, and individual key health testing.
  c) Dynamic Model Discovery: Old used static model lists; new must live-fetch available models directly from provider endpoints (/api/admin/ai/fetch-models).
  d) Cooldown & Circuit Breaking: Old had silent failures; new must show real-time backoff countdowns, failure reasons, and a manual 'Flush Cooldown' action.
  e) Prompt Compression & Token Budgets: Expose dedup and jsoncompact controls with real-time token savings telemetry.
  f) Visual Hierarchy & Polish: Exceed legacy UI in every dimension—crystal-clear status badges, fluid hover states, zero layout shift (CLS < 0.05), and distinct Cuba executive glassmorphism cards.

---

# SECTION 3 — 100% REAL DATA PRIORITY (ZERO FABRICATION)
In accordance with IME365 AGENTS.md Invariant 5.3:
- Production UI must NEVER display fabricated arrays, mock percentages, or fake latency numbers presented as real system state.
- Provider Catalog must reflect real supported providers from backend/freellmapi/providers/registry.js.
- Engine Health & Metrics must bind to real SQLite data (/v1/status and /data/freellm_metrics.db).
- Saved keys must reflect real MariaDB records in system_settings / ai_providers (with server-side masking).
- Latency probes must execute real network HTTP handshakes via POST /api/admin/ai/test-provider.
- When an API key is not configured, show clear, actionable empty states with 'Configure Key' actions rather than dummy placeholder statistics.

---

# SECTION 4 — DEEP LINKS & URL STATE MANAGEMENT
Verify and implement robust bidirectional URL sync for all engine surfaces:
- Route: /admin/ai-settings (resolves directly in Admin Console with activeTab='ai-settings').
- Subtab Deep Links:
  - ?tab=ai-settings&subtab=providers (Provider catalog & master configuration)
  - ?tab=ai-settings&subtab=key-pool (Multi-key pooling & load distribution)
  - ?tab=ai-settings&subtab=metrics (Real-time latency, error rates, and cooldowns)
  - ?tab=ai-settings&subtab=unified-gateway (OpenAI/Anthropic compatible /v1/* endpoints & code snippets)
  - ?tab=ai-settings&subtab=discovery (Dynamic live model discovery & catalog sync)
- Filter Deep Links:
  - ?tab=ai-settings&provider=groq (Deep links directly to Groq card and opens key management)
  - ?tab=ai-settings&category=fast (Filters catalog to high-speed inference providers)
- Browser Navigation: Back/Forward buttons must update subtabs without full-page reloads.

---

# SECTION 5 — MODALS, POPUPS & INTERACTIVE CENSUS
Audit, harden, and verify all engine modals:
1. 'Add Provider Key' Modal:
   - Secret key input with visibility toggle, paste helper, multi-key delimiter (comma/newline).
   - Base URL override input for self-hosted/custom proxy endpoints.
   - Model selection dropdown with live fetch option.
   - Instant 'Test Key Before Saving' button.
2. 'Key Pool Manager' Modal:
   - Shows all active keys in the pool with masked tokens ('sk-...ab12').
   - Status indicators (Healthy / 429 Cooldown / Invalid).
   - Ability to add, remove, or cycle keys individually.
3. 'Cooldown Details & Manual Flush' Modal:
   - Displays provider, model, cooldown expiration timestamp, and HTTP error trace.
   - 'Flush Cooldown Now' button to immediately restore provider into active rotation.
4. 'Dynamic Model Discovery' Drawer/Modal:
   - Live query of provider /models endpoint, showing model IDs, context windows, and pricing tier.
5. Modal UX Requirements:
   - Must trap focus, dismiss on Escape key, close on backdrop click, and prevent body background scrolling.
   - Must maintain full responsive containment (zero clipping or overflow on mobile viewports).

---

# SECTION 6 — PLAYWRIGHT E2E TESTING ACROSS 5 RESPONSIVE VIEWPORTS
The developer must execute real Playwright headless browser tests across all 5 target viewports:
1. Mobile: 375 x 667 (iPhone SE)
2. Tablet: 768 x 1024 (iPad Portrait)
3. Small Laptop: 1024 x 768 (Compact Screen)
4. Standard Desktop: 1440 x 900 (MacBook / Standard Laptop)
5. Ultrawide Desktop: 1920 x 1080 (Full HD Monitor)

Test Suite Verification Checklist:
- Full page layout renders with zero horizontal overflow (scrollWidth === clientWidth).
- Navigation between all subtabs works seamlessly via UI clicks and deep links.
- Interactive controls (provider enable/disable switches, save button, test connection buttons) are visible, accessible, and responsive.
- Modals open, display correctly centered within viewport, and close cleanly.
- Capture full-page screenshots for every viewport and save into docs/ui-audit/screenshots/freellmapi/.

---

# SECTION 7 — SUBSYSTEM INTEGRATION (TRUE 10/10 ZERO GAPS)
Verify full bidirectional integration across all platform subsystems:
- Super Admin: Setting primary provider or toggling fallback instantly updates backend runtime configuration without requiring server restart.
- Candidate Experience: Resume Builder (/resumes/build) and Interview Coach (/interview/coach) successfully route completions through the configured FreeLLMAPI engine.
- Enterprise Console: Tenant BYOK configurations (/enterprise/ai) air-gapped and sealed with AES-256-GCM envelope encryption.
- Public SDK Gateway: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/messages, /v1/models, and /v1/status respond with accurate headers and OpenAI/Anthropic wire parity.

---

# SECTION 8 — AUTONOMOUS 5-HOUR WORKFLOW & STRICT LEAD GOVERNANCE
Because the user is away for 5 hours, the developer and lead must operate autonomously:
1. PLAN MODE: Developer inspects old vs. new UIs, deep links, modals, and tests, then submits detailed implementation plan via bridge dev plan.
2. STRICT LEAD REVIEW: Lead evaluates plan against all 10/10 criteria. Vague or skipped steps will be rejected with CHANGES_REQUESTED.
3. ACT MODE: Upon approval, developer implements surgical code improvements and executes automated test suites.
4. EVIDENCE SUBMISSION: Developer submits Playwright test logs, DOM audit, and screenshot manifests via bridge dev submit-evidence.
5. GATEKEEPER CERTIFICATION: Lead audits submitted evidence and certifies production freeze.
invariants: Zero plaintext API key leakage: All provider secrets masked on server and never exposed in client DOM, logs, or unencrypted storage
Single Source of Truth: Zero code duplication between backend/freellmapi/ and backend/services/aiGateway/
Real Data Integrity: Production features must display real database/API records, not synthetic dummy arrays
WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance: All interactive elements have accessible names, >= 4.5:1 text contrast, and full keyboard accessibility
Responsive Layout Integrity: Zero horizontal scrolling or clipping across all 5 target viewports (375px to 1920px)
Zero Dead or Duplicate Legacy Code in Production: Production source trees must contain exactly ONE canonical implementation. All replaced legacy code must be cleanly archived post-verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Old vs. New comprehensive comparative audit documented, confirming new AI Multi-Provider Engine achieves 100% feature parity and exceeds old in visual elegance, responsive ergonomics, and intelligent automation
Modern Cuba M3 executive glassmorphic styling implemented across AdminAiSettingsTab.tsx with crisp typography, curated HSL color tokens, dark/light contrast, and zero layout shift

100% Real Data Integration: All provider catalogs, latency tests, SQLite metrics, cooldowns, and live model discovery bind to authentic backend APIs and MariaDB stores; zero synthetic arrays or placeholder mocks presented as real features

Deep Links Verification: Direct URL routing works flawlessly for /admin/ai-settings and all subtabs (?subtab=providers, ?subtab=key-pool, ?subtab=metrics, ?subtab=unified-gateway, ?subtab=discovery, and ?provider=<id>) without state loss

Modal & Popup Census: All dialogs (Add Key, Key Pool Manager, Cooldown Flush, Model Discovery, Code Snippets) feature focus trapping, WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard navigation, Escape dismissal, and responsive viewport containment

Playwright 5-Viewport E2E Certification: Real-DOM headless browser tests pass across all 5 viewports (375x667, 768x1024, 1024x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080) with zero horizontal overflow and high-resolution audit screenshots saved to docs/ui-audit/screenshots/freellmapi/
Full Subsystem Integration: Provider configuration changes immediately govern Candidate Resume Builder, Interview Coach, Super Admin, and Enterprise BYOK routing without regression
Quality Gates Exited at True 10/10: npx tsc -b exits 0, frontend build exits 0 within <3.0s budget, and all backend test suites pass with 100% green status

Post-Verification Archival: Once the new FreeLLMAPI AI Multi-Provider Engine passes all verification gates, safely archive legacy backend/services/aiRouting/ and deprecated reference components into backend/archive/aiRouting-deprecated/ with an archival manifest. Zero legacy duplicates may remain in active production paths.
